description: A chaotic CV generator running the logistic map, r times x times one minus x, one step per clock, with x sent out as a voltage.

params.text: Sets the internal clock, 0.25Hz at the bottom of the travel to 64Hz at the top; nothing reads it while a cable is in EXT CLOCK, and the tooltip prints the exponent rather than the rate.
Sets the r term of the equation, 0 to 8; the default 3.56995 is where the map turns chaotic.
Sets the value x is put back to by a reset, 0 to 0.5.
Puts x back to the value set by the X0 knob, taking effect at the next clock step rather than at once.

inputs.text: One rising edge advances the map a step, and a cable here takes the place of the internal clock.
A rising edge puts x back to the value set by the X0 knob, at the next clock step.
Adds to the R knob, one unit of r per volt, the two together held between 0 and 8.

outputs.text: The current value of x, 0V to 10V.

notes: The module computes nothing at all while the output jack is unpatched.
The internal clock runs on its own, so the map steps along with no clock cable patched.
x is held between 0.00001 and 1, which keeps the map from settling on zero for good when r is low.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
0 to 8V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 8V.
